seo.title: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Salt Lake City - No Home Help
seo.description: Current Salt Lake City contacts for shelter, meals, day services, health care, benefits, jobs, legal help and specialist support.

page.heading: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Salt Lake City
page.urgent: Immediate danger, serious injury, overdose, fire or a crime in progress: call 911. Mental-health or substance-use crisis: call or text 988. Shelter and current bed information: call 801-990-9999.
page.notice: Shelters and services can be full, change hours or require an assessment. Call before travelling whenever possible. No listing guarantees a bed, housing, appointment, benefit, payment, treatment or job.
page.intro: If one shelter is full, call the Homeless Services Line and try another appropriate route below. Say your age, gender or household type, whether children or a pet are with you, and any urgent health, safety, mobility or language needs. Ask about overflow, outreach and the next safe option instead of relying on one address.
page.footer: No Home Help is independent of government and service providers. Information was checked against official provider or government pages; report a change if a number, address or access rule is no longer correct.

entries.title: 911 — emergency services
entries.description: Call for immediate danger, serious injury, suspected overdose, fire or a crime in progress. Give the exact address or nearest intersection and describe the immediate risk.
entries.how_to_access: Call 911. Do not use a shelter or crisis-line number instead when someone needs an ambulance, fire response or immediate police help.

entries.title: Salt Lake County Homeless Services Line
entries.description: Central contact for current bed information and intake or diversion at Salt Lake County homeless resource centers. Capacity changes during the day, and calling does not reserve or guarantee a bed.
entries.hours: Published staffed hours: daily 07:00–17:30; leave a voicemail if unanswered
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain who needs shelter and any accessibility, health, safety or pet needs. Ask which intake route is appropriate and what to do if every suitable center is full.

entries.title: Utah 211 — community-service referrals
entries.description: Statewide information and referral for food, housing, health care, transportation, legal help, benefits and other local services. A navigator can search for more than one current option.
entries.address: Telephone and online service
entries.how_to_access: Call 211 or use the online directory. Ask the navigator to confirm eligibility, hours and whether an appointment is required.

entries.title: 988 Utah — mental-health and substance-use crisis
entries.description: Call or text for crisis counselling and connection to a mobile crisis team or receiving center when appropriate. This is not a substitute for 911 during immediate physical danger or a medical emergency.
entries.address: Telephone, text and online access
entries.how_to_access: Call or text 988. Say where you are and whether you need someone to talk to, a mobile response or a safe crisis-care location.

entries.title: Pamela Atkinson Men's Resource Center
entries.description: Emergency resource center for adult men, including transgender men and nonbinary adults who feel best served in a men's setting. Services include shelter, meals, showers, laundry, housing navigation and case management. A bed is not guaranteed.
entries.address: 3380 S 1000 W, South Salt Lake, UT 84119
entries.hours: Resource center operates 24 hours; intake and bed-assignment times can change
entries.how_to_access: Call 801-990-9999 first for current bed and intake information. Ask what time to arrive and what alternative is available if full.

entries.title: Gail Miller Resource Center
entries.description: Emergency resource center for adults of all genders, with shelter, meals, basic needs, housing support and case management. Eligibility and capacity are assessed at intake.
entries.address: 242 W Paramount Avenue, Salt Lake City, UT 84115
entries.hours: Resource center operates 24 hours; call for current intake
entries.how_to_access: Call 801-990-9999 for bed availability and intake instructions. Calling the center does not guarantee a bed.

entries.title: Geraldine E. King Women's Resource Center
entries.description: Emergency resource center for adult women, including transgender women and nonbinary adults who feel best served in a women's setting. It provides shelter, meals, hygiene, laundry and housing support and welcomes companion animals subject to center rules.
entries.address: 131 E 700 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
entries.hours: 24 hours; intake and bed availability change
entries.how_to_access: Call 801-990-9999 or inquire at the center or Weigand Resource Center. Ask about current capacity and pet arrangements before travelling.

entries.title: VOA Youth Resource Center — ages 15 to 22
entries.description: Drop-in center and overnight emergency shelter for young people ages 15 to 22 who are homeless or at imminent risk. Services include three meals, showers, laundry, medical and dental assistance, mental-health access and housing and employment case management.
entries.address: 888 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Drop-in 08:30–19:30; published intake 08:30–18:00; enrolled shelter clients receive 24-hour services
entries.how_to_access: Arrive during drop-in hours and ask for intake, or call extension 707. Confirm current age eligibility, intake time and bed availability.

entries.title: Connie Crosby Family Resource Center — families
entries.description: Emergency shelter and housing support for families with children and certain pregnant households. The center is in Midvale and serves the wider Salt Lake County area. Capacity and household eligibility change.
entries.address: 529 W 9th Avenue, Midvale, UT 84047
entries.how_to_access: Call 801-990-9999 and state that children are present, or call the family center. Ask what documents to bring and what alternative is available if full.

entries.title: Rescue Mission of Salt Lake — men's shelter
entries.description: Faith-based homeless service center offering limited emergency shelter for men, meals, hygiene, clothing, family food boxes and addiction recovery. Space is limited and program expectations vary.
entries.address: 463 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Open every day; call for current shelter intake
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling and ask about the current check-in time, identification rules, chapel or program expectations and the next option if no space is available.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul Dining Hall
entries.description: Catholic Community Services dining hall providing prepared meals to people experiencing homelessness and food insecurity. Serving times can change on holidays or during emergencies.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Call the Weigand and dining-hall number before a long journey and ask for the next meal time and any entry procedure.

entries.title: Crossroads Urban Center — emergency food pantry
entries.description: Emergency groceries and necessities for households in need. Supplies and service limits depend on available donations.
entries.address: 347 S 400 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit during published hours. Ask what information is needed and whether the pantry can serve you again if you have visited recently.

entries.title: Utah Food Bank — find a nearby pantry
entries.description: Official locator for food pantries and mobile distributions across the Salt Lake area. Partner sites set their own schedules and rules.
entries.address: Use the official locator for the nearest distribution
entries.how_to_access: Search by address or ZIP code, then call the selected pantry to confirm the date, hours and required documents before travelling.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — daytime services
entries.description: Catholic Community Services day center open to all. It provides daytime refuge, case management, storage, showers, laundry, hygiene supplies, a computer lab, job and benefits help and a limited clothing room. Services are practical and not a shelter bed.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Daily 07:00–19:00; closed 11:00–12:30 for lunch and on holidays
entries.how_to_access: Walk in and complete the center's intake form. Arrive early for time-limited services and ask staff which service to queue for first.

entries.title: Rescue Mission of Salt Lake — basic-needs support
entries.description: Christian service center offering meals, hygiene, clothing, shelter and recovery programs. Some activities are explicitly faith-based; ask what participation is expected before joining a residential or recovery program.
entries.address: 463 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Open every day; individual service times vary
entries.how_to_access: Call or ask at the front desk for the next meal, hygiene, clothing or shelter service. Ask about requirements for the specific service you need.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — showers and laundry
entries.description: Day center with showers, laundry and hygiene products. Demand can exceed daily capacity.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Arrive early, complete intake and ask how shower and laundry sign-ups work that day. Bring only the amount of laundry staff can accept.

entries.title: Rescue Mission of Salt Lake — hygiene services
entries.description: The men's homeless service center lists hygiene among its basic services. Access times and supplies can change.
entries.address: 463 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Call for the current hygiene schedule
entries.how_to_access: Call or ask at the service desk for current shower or hygiene access and whether shelter guests are prioritised.

entries.title: Crossroads Thrift Store — clothing by referral or voucher
entries.description: Most donated clothing and household items are given away to people with a voucher from a Crossroads pantry or community partner. Sizes and stock are not guaranteed.
entries.address: 1385 W Indiana Avenue, Salt Lake City, UT 84104
entries.how_to_access: Contact a Crossroads food pantry or another referring partner about a voucher, then confirm the store hours and available items.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — clothing room
entries.description: Limited donated clothing for day-center clients. The provider publishes clothing-room access on Tuesday and Friday mornings; stock and sizes vary.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Published clothing hours Tuesday and Friday 07:15–10:15
entries.how_to_access: Complete center intake and arrive early. Confirm the clothing-room schedule because holidays and supply can affect access.

entries.title: Fourth Street Clinic — homeless health care
entries.description: Primary medical, dental, behavioral-health and pharmacy services for people experiencing homelessness. Walk-ins are accepted, but same-day care is not guaranteed; services depend on clinical need and capacity.
entries.address: 409 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Medical Monday 08:00–18:00, Tuesday 09:00–18:00, Wednesday–Thursday 08:00–18:00, Friday 08:00–17:00; other clinics differ
entries.how_to_access: Call the appointment line or walk in for triage. Ask about medical, dental, behavioral-health or pharmacy access. Call 911 for a life-threatening emergency.

entries.title: 988 Utah — crisis counselling and mobile response
entries.description: Immediate support for suicide, mental-health or substance-use crises, with connection to mobile response or a receiving center when appropriate.
entries.address: Telephone, text and online access
entries.how_to_access: Call or text 988. Call 911 instead for immediate danger, a serious injury or another medical emergency.

entries.title: Fourth Street Clinic — behavioral health and substance-use care
entries.description: Behavioral-health clinic for people experiencing homelessness, including medically assisted substance-use treatment options when clinically appropriate.
entries.address: 409 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Behavioral health Monday 08:30–18:00, Tuesday 09:00–18:00, Wednesday–Thursday 08:30–18:00, Friday 08:30–17:00
entries.how_to_access: Call or walk in and ask for behavioral-health triage. Same-day care is not guaranteed. Use 988 for an immediate crisis.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — indoor day refuge
entries.description: Indoor daytime space with toilets and access to case management, hygiene and other basic services. It is not an overnight bed except when a separately announced winter service is active.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Walk in and complete intake. Ask staff about today's service queues and closing time.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — computer lab
entries.description: Computers for job searches, benefit applications, resumes and other essential online tasks, with staff assistance when available.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: During center hours; access may be time-limited
entries.how_to_access: Complete intake and ask for the computer-lab sign-up procedure. Bring account information or application details if available, but protect passwords and personal data.

entries.title: Salt Lake City Main Library — computers and internet
entries.description: Public library with internet computers, Wi-Fi, printing and information help. Computer sessions and printing may have limits or charges.
entries.address: 210 E 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
entries.hours: Check the library's current hours before travelling
entries.how_to_access: Ask library staff about a guest computer pass, Wi-Fi, charging and low-cost printing. Keep personal documents and passwords secure on public devices.

entries.title: UTA Reduced Fare FAREPAY Card
entries.description: Reduced local and premium fares for qualifying low-income riders, people with disabilities, seniors and youth. Approval and proof of eligibility are required.
entries.address: Meadowbrook customer service: 3600 S 700 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84119
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or at a customer-service location with identity and eligibility evidence. Ask a case manager at Weigand or a resource center if you need help with documents.

entries.title: Utah Workforce Services — SNAP, medical and cash assistance
entries.description: Applications for SNAP food assistance and other qualifying support. SNAP benefits begin from the application date if approved, and expedited service may be available for some households.
entries.address: Apply online, by telephone or at a Workforce Services employment center
entries.how_to_access: Apply online through myCase or request an application by phone. You do not need all documents to submit the initial SNAP application; follow up promptly on verification requests.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — benefit-enrolment help
entries.description: Day-center staff and in-house partners can help clients identify and apply for benefit programs. Approval remains with the administering agency.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: During center hours; partner schedules vary
entries.how_to_access: Complete center intake and ask when benefit-enrolment assistance is available. Bring any identification, notices or case numbers you already have.

entries.title: Utah Workforce Services — job and training help
entries.description: Employment-center and online services can help with job search, training eligibility, career planning and connections to employers. Program eligibility varies.
entries.address: Use the official locator for the nearest employment center
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or visit an employment center. Ask for help creating a Utah ID account if online access or identification is a barrier.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — resume and job-application help
entries.description: Computer lab and staff help for resumes, job searches and applications. This service does not guarantee employment.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: During center hours; staff availability varies
entries.how_to_access: Complete intake and ask for computer-lab or employment assistance. Bring work history and contact details if available.

entries.title: Utah Legal Services — civil legal aid
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income Utah residents, including some housing, public-benefit, family and consumer matters. Representation is not guaranteed.
entries.address: 960 S Main Street, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Call or apply online; appointment and public-office hours vary
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or call intake before visiting. Explain any eviction, hearing or filing deadline immediately.

entries.title: VOA Youth Resource Center — youth legal clinic
entries.description: Free legal consultation, education and representation for eligible youth already accessing the Youth Resource Center, with focus on barriers to employment, housing and independence.
entries.address: 888 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.hours: Ask the Youth Resource Center for the current clinic schedule
entries.how_to_access: Enroll with the Youth Resource Center and ask staff for a legal-clinic referral. Tell staff about any urgent court or filing deadline.

entries.title: Homeless resource centers — replacement-document help for guests
entries.description: Current guests at the King, Midvale family and Pamela Atkinson resource centers can ask staff for help obtaining state identification, birth certificates or Social Security cards. Assistance depends on eligibility and available funds.
entries.address: Ask at your assigned resource center
entries.how_to_access: Ask your shelter case manager what evidence is needed and whether fees can be covered. Keep copies or photos of documents in a secure account when possible.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — limited storage
entries.description: The day center lists storage facilities among its client services. Space, item limits and length of use are controlled by the center.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Complete intake and ask staff about current availability, prohibited items, access times and how long belongings may remain.

entries.title: YWCA Utah — domestic-violence crisis line and shelter
entries.description: Confidential crisis support and emergency shelter for people experiencing domestic violence, including adults and children regardless of sexual orientation. The shelter address and space are managed through the crisis line.
entries.address: Confidential shelter location
entries.how_to_access: Call the crisis line from a safe device if possible. Say if children, accessibility needs or immediate danger are involved. Call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: South Valley Services — shelter and survivor support
entries.description: Crisis line, safe shelter and support for adults and children affected by domestic or sexual violence. Services are available to people of all genders; shelter space is not guaranteed.
entries.address: Advocacy office: 2860 W 4700 S, Suite H, West Valley City, UT 84119; shelter location is confidential
entries.how_to_access: Call or text from a safe device. Ask about shelter, safety planning, transport and a backup option if no room is available.

entries.title: Volunteers of America Utah — homeless outreach team
entries.description: Street outreach for people experiencing unsheltered homelessness, with connection to basic needs, shelter, behavioural-health care and housing services.
entries.address: Mobile outreach across the Salt Lake area
entries.how_to_access: Call and give a clear location, description and immediate needs. Call 911 instead for a medical emergency or immediate danger.

entries.title: VOA Youth Resource Center — drop-in support ages 15 to 22
entries.description: Specialist youth service offering meals, hygiene, health connections, case management, employment support and emergency shelter.
entries.address: 888 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Walk in during drop-in hours or call extension 707. Confirm age eligibility and current intake before travelling.

entries.title: VA Salt Lake City — homeless veteran care
entries.description: VA care coordinators help eligible veterans who are homeless or at risk with immediate food and shelter referrals, housing, employment and training, benefits, addiction and mental-health care and justice-system re-entry.
entries.address: VA Salt Lake City Health Care System
entries.hours: Call extension 2746; national homeless-veteran line 877-424-3838 is available 24 hours
entries.how_to_access: Call the local homeless outreach team at extension 2746 or the national line. You do not need to prove eligibility before making the first call.

entries.title: Ruff Haven — temporary pet crisis sheltering
entries.description: Short-term shelter or foster care for dogs and cats when an owner faces a qualifying crisis such as homelessness, eviction, domestic violence, hospitalisation or treatment. Space and eligibility are assessed; acceptance is not guaranteed.
entries.address: Salt Lake City, UT 84104; exact intake arranged after approval
entries.hours: Apply online; response time and capacity vary
entries.how_to_access: Complete the official application and describe the crisis, pet and expected care period. Ask a shelter case manager for help applying if you lack internet access.

entries.title: King Women's Resource Center — companion animals
entries.description: The women's resource center states that it welcomes companion animals as part of its emergency shelter environment. Rules, capacity and arrangements vary.
entries.address: 131 E 700 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
entries.how_to_access: Tell the Homeless Services Line and center staff about the animal before travelling. Ask what supplies, records or behaviour rules apply and request a backup pet option if the center cannot accommodate it.

entries.title: Salt Lake City Homeless Services Dashboard
entries.description: City page linking to current shelter locations, the state bed-availability dashboard, outreach and homeless-service contacts. It is useful for checking updates but does not itself reserve a bed.
entries.address: Online resource
entries.how_to_access: Use the page to check current provider information, then call the Homeless Services Line or provider before travelling.
